forbidden: No VWAP, RSI, MACD, FVG, CHoCH, DOM, MBP, MBO, delta, sweep, MA filters. Not a news strategy. Not a DVP clone. Do not reopen a large OR-window or penetration grid. Do not enter the Phase 38 immediate breakout.

phase38_baseline.note: Phase 38 verdict BREAKOUT_EDGE_WEAK is source of truth. 91-92% returned inside the range. That is not evidence that retests work.

opening_range.or_valid_at: window close. No trade may use OR levels before that close.

retest_trigger_family.T0_exact: PRIMARY. Long: 1m low <= OR_HIGH. Short: 1m high >= OR_LOW.
retest_trigger_family.T1_two_ticks: Long: 1m low <= OR_HIGH + 2 ticks. Short: 1m high >= OR_LOW - 2 ticks. Approach within 2 ticks counts.
retest_trigger_family.T2_five_pct_width: Long: 1m low <= OR_HIGH + min(0.05*OR_WIDTH, 8 ticks). Short inverse. Cap prevents huge-range pathology.

retest_fail_family.fail_0pct: Any strict trade inside the range (penetration > 0) fails.
retest_fail_family.fail_10pct: PRIMARY. Fail if max penetration > 0.10 * OR_WIDTH.

confirmation_family.A_range: After a valid retest, first 1m range trades back outside the broken boundary. Fill = boundary +/- 1 tick (not wick extreme).
confirmation_family.B_close_1m: PRIMARY. After a valid retest, completed 1m close back outside the broken boundary. Entry at next 1m open +/- 1 tick.
confirmation_family.C_close_5m: Diagnostic. After a valid retest, RTH-aligned 5m close back outside. Entry at next 5m open +/- 1 tick.

retest_expiry_note: 30 minutes after breakout confirmation close. Not optimized.
opposite_boundary_before_confirm: BREAKOUT_INVALIDATED. Range trades through the opposite OR boundary. No reversal trade.

stops.A_retest_extreme: PRIMARY. Long SL = retest_low - 1 tick. Short SL = retest_high + 1 tick.
stops.B_boundary_2ticks: Long SL = OR_HIGH - 2 ticks. Short SL = OR_LOW + 2 ticks.
stops.P38_opposite: Read-only comparison. Long SL = OR_LOW. Short SL = OR_HIGH. Not a Phase 39 primary.

same_bar_stop_and_target: AMBIGUOUS — do not assume target first

news.bls_0830_pm5: Does not overlap RTH 09:30 entries. Report 0 removed.
news.slot_1000_et_pm5: Diagnostic count of would-be entries in 09:55-10:05 ET. Not a primary filter. No invented 10:00 event calendar.
news.fomc: Not used as a trade filter.

primary_candidate.reason: Shallow first return to the exact broken OR15 boundary, 1m close hold, next-bar market fill, stop beyond the retest extreme. Locked before Phase 39 P&L. 1R is the middle of the target family.

note: Phase 39 is the final ORB research phase. No freeze. Candidate JSON only if ORB_RETEST_EDGE_FOUND.
